data.one_liner: Unified ESC/POS thermal printer package for USB, Bluetooth, BLE, and Network connections.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single PrinterManager API to discover printers and print tickets via USB, Bluetooth Classic, BLE, and Network connections. It supports full ESC/POS command generation including text formatting, images, barcodes, QR codes, tables, and multilingual text rasterization.
use_when: You need to print receipts or tickets from Flutter to thermal printers using USB, Bluetooth, BLE, or Network.
You require multi-language support (such as CJK or Arabic) rendered as images on thermal printers.
avoid_when: You are building a web-based app, as web browsers lack raw TCP, SPP, or USB access required by this package.
You need to print standard PDF documents instead of raw ESC/POS text and receipt commands.
strengths: Supports multiple connection types (Network, Bluetooth Classic, BLE, USB) through a single unified API.
Built-in device discovery and capability profiles for over 200 printer models.
Supports multilingual text rasterization using Flutter's text engine.
weaknesses: Not functional on the web platform due to browser hardware limitations.
Requires platform-specific permission setups on Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding network, bluetooth, or USB permissions and features to Android's AndroidManifest.xml and usage descriptions to iOS's Info.plist depending on the connection types used.
